games.name: Pears to Pairs Card Game
games.desc:
Welcome to Pears to Pairs, a simple, fun, and hilarious tabletop card game! 🍐

The rules for the game are simple. Each player is given a random set of cards that are objects/phrases. At the start of each round, a judge is selected along with a random card, an adjective. Your goal? Select a card that you think the judge will pair with their card to win! 🏆

With 1500+ different game cards and various game modes, you are sure to come up with crazy card combinations and have endless hours of fun! At least 3 players in a server are needed to play. 🎮

With full device cross compatibility, you can play the game on the go on your phone or tablet. Your cards and win stats also save between all devices and servers. Private servers are free to rent to play specifically with your friends! 📱
